name: Emergency services
description: Police, ambulance or fire brigade. Works from any cell phone.

name: Police (SAPS)
description: Report a crime or ask the police for help.

name: Suicide crisis line (SADAG)
description: If you are thinking about ending your life, or you are worried about someone who is. You will not be judged.

name: Mental health helpline (SADAG)
description: Free counselling and support for stress, anxiety, low mood and more.

name: Lifeline counselling
description: Confidential counselling from trained volunteers, when you need someone to talk to.

name: GBV Command Centre
description: Free, confidential help if you or someone you know is experiencing gender-based violence.

name: University switchboard
description: The main university number, if you are not sure who to call.
